title: Instruction Data Selection via Answer Divergence
authors_zh: Bo Li, Mingda Wang, Shikun Zhang, Wei Ye
paper_type_zh: 多样答案驱动的指令数据选择论文（ACL 2026）
best_for_zh: 研究指令数据筛选、模型中心评分和高效 SFT 的读者。
one_line: ADG selects instruction data by the geometry of multiple answers sampled from the target model.
ADG 依据从目标模型采样的多个答案的几何结构选择指令数据。
why: It makes the connection between a data object and its training objective inspectable.
inclusion_reason: It changes how a training record, selection decision, or reward signal is consumed by a post-training objective.

title: Problem
问题
html:
A fixed supervised fine-tuning budget cannot absorb every available instruction, yet common selectors often infer usefulness from one reference response, one loss value, or one uncertainty estimate. A single answer can confuse harmless stylistic variation with a genuine learning gap, while a high-loss prompt may simply be ambiguous or poorly specified. The result is that a small training set can spend capacity on redundant examples or on disagreement that offers no teachable structure.

ADG asks whether several answers sampled from the intended backbone reveal a richer selection signal than one target alone. It describes each instruction by the geometry of five generated answers, then selects 10K instruction records from public pools for SFT. The question is not whether the answers are already correct, but whether their pattern of variation indicates an example whose consumption may improve the model under a fixed training budget.

固定的监督微调预算无法容纳所有可得指令，但常见选择器往往从一个参考回复、一个损失值或一个不确定性估计推断样本价值。单一答案可能把无害的风格差异误认为真正的学习缺口，而高损失提示也可能只是含糊或规定不足。结果是，小型训练集会把容量花在重复例子上，或花在没有可教结构的分歧上。

ADG 追问：从目标基模型为同一指令采样多个答案，能否提供比单一目标更丰富的选择信号？它用五个生成答案的几何结构描述每条指令，再从公开语料池中选择 10K 条指令记录用于 SFT。问题并不是这些答案是否已经正确，而是它们的变化模式是否表明该样本在固定训练预算下被消费后能改善模型。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The final training object is still an instruction-response pair, but selection first creates a five-answer behavior record for the intended backbone. Rather than treating one target response as the sole observation, ADG pools representations from several sampled answers and asks how far apart, and in which directions, they lie. This makes selection explicitly model-relative: a prompt can be informative for one backbone and uninformative for another.

The score combines dispersion magnitude with anisotropy, so high value requires both meaningful variation and a multi-directional answer shape rather than one elongated cluster. Examples are then placed into semantic bins and selected under proportional quotas. Coverage is part of the decision: without it, a high-scoring but narrow topic region could consume the 10K budget and reduce the variety of supervision seen during fine-tuning.

最终训练对象仍是指令—回复对，但选择阶段会先为目标基模型生成一条五答案行为记录。ADG 不把一个目标回复当作唯一观察，而是池化多个采样答案的表征，并考察它们相隔多远、朝哪些方向分布。这使选择显式地依赖于模型：同一提示对一个基模型可能有信息量，对另一个基模型则未必如此。

该分数结合离散幅度和各向异性，因此高价值同时需要有意义的变化和多方向的答案形状，而不是一个被拉长的簇。样本随后进入语义箱，并在比例配额下被选取。覆盖度是决策的一部分：没有它，一个高分但主题狭窄的区域可能耗尽 10K 预算，减少微调中可见监督的多样性。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Sample five answers per instruction at temperature 1.4. 2. Pool final-layer hidden states, embed answers, and compute dispersion and anisotropy.
  1. Cluster into 1,000 semantic bins and keep top-ranked examples under proportional quotas until 10K records remain. 4. Fine-tune LLaMA3-8B or Qwen2.5-7B with a matched recipe; code, project, and a model are released, but no new dataset is released.

1. 以温度 1.4 为每条指令采样五个答案。2. 池化最后层隐藏状态，嵌入答案，并计算离散程度和各向异性。
  1. 聚为 1,000 个语义箱，按比例配额保留高分样本，直到剩下 10K 条记录。4. 用匹配配方微调 LLaMA3-8B 或 Qwen2.5-7B；代码、项目页和模型已公开，但没有发布新数据集。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across three pools, two backbones, fixed 10K budgets, and five seeds, ADG has the best average score in all six settings. On CoT/LLaMA3-8B it reports 62.71, versus 61.12 for Rethinking, 61.05 for MIG, and 60.73 for ZIP.

Ablation gives 50.85 for full ADG, 43.75 for dispersion alone, and 43.88 for anisotropy alone. This supports the combined score under the reported configuration, not a claim that all high divergence is useful.

在三个语料池、两个基模型、固定 10K 预算和五个随机种子下，ADG 在六个设置中都取得最高平均分。在 CoT/LLaMA3-8B 上，它为 62.71，Rethinking 为 61.12，MIG 为 61.05，ZIP 为 60.73。

消融中，完整 ADG 为 50.85，只用离散程度为 43.75，只用各向异性为 43.88。这支持所报告配置下的组合分数，而不是说所有高分歧都一定有用。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Single-reference selectors use loss, uncertainty, or one target response. ADG changes the observed object to the geometry of multiple sampled answers before ranking training records.

Its coverage bins are part of the selection decision; multi-sampling and SFT themselves are not new. Test-time self-consistency is excluded because it answers a prompt instead of selecting training data.

单一参考选择器使用损失、不确定性或一个目标回复。ADG 在给训练记录排序前，将观察对象改为多个采样答案的几何结构。

覆盖分箱是选择决策的一部分；多次采样和 SFT 本身并不新。测试时自一致性被排除，因为它回答提示而不是选择训练数据。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The fixed pooling/layer design may affect signal quality, and high divergence can come from an ambiguous or underspecified prompt. Inspect selected examples and add clarity filters for unreliable pools.
固定的池化和层设计可能影响信号质量，高分歧也可能来自含糊或监督不足的提示。应检查被选样本，并对不可靠语料池加入清晰度过滤。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use it when multiple student-model samples per prompt are affordable: score them, preserve semantic coverage, and compare the 10K subset with random and reference-based selectors under identical SFT. Do not treat answer divergence as a truth verifier.
当能够负担为每条提示从学生模型采样多个答案时可使用它：给答案打分、保持语义覆盖，并在相同 SFT 下将 10K 子集与随机和参考式选择器比较。不要把答案分歧当成真实性验证器。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Sample five answers; score their joint geometry; keep both dispersion and anisotropy; preserve coverage; and compare over repeated seeds. The main CoT/LLaMA3-8B result is 62.71, but the first audit asks whether disagreement is learning value or ambiguity.
先采样五个答案；给其联合几何打分；同时保留离散和各向异性；维持覆盖；在重复种子下比较。CoT/LLaMA3-8B 的主结果为 62.71，但首要审计是分歧反映学习价值还是含糊性。
